name: matm
description: Manuel Tarouca's personal Claude Code marketplace: own skills, plus third-party skill collections tracked live from their upstream repos.

plugins.name: matm-skills
plugins.description: Manuel's own skills. Currently: codex-imagegen, local image generation through the Codex CLI with no API keys.

plugins.name: phaser
plugins.description: Official Phaser 4 skills, tracked live from the phaserjs/phaser repo: scenes, sprites, tweens, animations, arcade & matter physics, tilemaps, particles, cameras, input, audio, filters/postfx, scale, and v3-to-v4 migration.

plugins.name: elevenlabs
plugins.description: Official ElevenLabs skills, tracked from a light fork of elevenlabs/skills: text-to-speech, music, sound effects, dubbing, speech-to-text, voice changer, voice isolator, speech engine, and conversational agents. Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

plugins.name: chrome-devtools
plugins.description: Drive and debug Chrome from Claude: DOM and network inspection, performance traces, LCP and memory-leak analysis, accessibility auditing. Bundles the official chrome-devtools-mcp server plus its six skills.
